title: reproducing inequality? social capital, digital literacy, and ses in access to higher education
core_idea: Investigate how social capital shapes access to higher education for Chinese high school graduates and how digital literacy and socioeconomic status interact with social capital to influence learning opportunities, using survey data and regression-based analyses to examine underlying mechanisms.
tldr: Study aims to examine the roles of social capital, digital literacy, and SES in shaping Chinese high school graduates' access to higher education through survey data (n=629 across western, central, and eastern provinces) and regression/group regression analyses to analyze mechanisms.
